what: S2-4S provisioned per-episode tariff q_S for StartLux-Decision-4B (docs/PREREG_A7_STAGE2.md A7.18 (e) 5, measured exactly as A7.13 (iii))

configuration.profile: configs/harness/jevagent_best.yaml (Flash section with the fitted backends.startlux_4b block)
configuration.system1: StartLux-Decision-4B, vendor server (startlux_decision.server, original weights, bf16) on :8090, one request at a time
configuration.system1_cache: cache/s1_dev_tariff_sl4b.sqlite (fresh; same per-backend cache policy as the evaluation)

warmup.purpose: covers the input lengths first seen by the server (first request at a new padded length compiles kernels, ~10 s); outside the window, not counted

window.start: the UTC time the workload command is launched (after the warm-up)
window.end: the UTC time the workload command exits
window.recorded_in: results/stage2/startlux/tariff_window.json (written by the box, scripts/aws/stage2_startlux.sh stage tariff)
window.contents: only the workload: no other job runs on the GPU host inside the window; executor waiting and provisioned idle time inside it are included

host.price_source: AWS Price List API (AmazonEC2, Linux, shared tenancy, on demand), read 2026-10-03

formula: q_S = host $/h x (window end - window start) / completed development episodes (latest record without an infrastructure error); scripts/stage2_tariff.py --arm jevagent_best_sl4b --served-model StartLux-Decision-4B --out results/stage2/tariff_sl4b.json
served_model_price: StartLux-Decision-4B is an exact 0 per-token entry in configs/prices/models.yaml (nothing charged twice)
sensitivity: busy-throughput tariff, Jev's API price, $0 and the realised evaluation-host bill reported beside it (A7.13 (iii))
